Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As the <strong>Director, Technical Architects</strong> on GitLab's <strong>AMER Professional Services</strong> team, you oversee one of the most technically credible and customer-facing groups in the organization. This team helps turn customer priorities into real adoption and measurable outcomes by guiding complex implementations, shaping new service patterns, and bringing emerging GitLab capabilities into production environments.</p> <p>You'll own the Global Technical Architecture practice across both presales and delivery, managing a team of AMER Technical Architects who work on complex customer needs, early-stage offerings, and strategic engagements. This role is well suited for someone who can coach senior technical talent, bring structure to ambiguity, and keep the team focused on customer outcomes instead of task completion.</p> <p>In your first year, you'll focus on stabilizing and growing the team, tightening the link between presales scoping and delivery, and turning field work into repeatable offerings. You'll work alongside architects in areas including AI, security, and broader platform architecture, while helping the team turn what they learn in the field into repeatable methods that can scale across Professional Services.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Running technical discovery, scoping, and delivery for complex Professional Services engagements in AMER</li> <li>Turning early customer work on new GitLab capabilities into repeatable delivery kits, standards, and service patterns</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hire, manage, and develop a growing AMER Technical Architecture team, including Intermediate, Senior, and Staff Technical Architects working across platform, AI, and security-related customer engagements.</li> <li>Lead the global Technical Architecture practice, aligning architects in AMER, EMEA, and APJ on shared standards for scoping, statement of work review, service offerings and delivery leadership.</li> utilization, delivery quality, and forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Coach architects to grow from hands-on implementers into technical leaders and credible advisors on most of their engagements, with a GitLab capabilities, helping shape how emerging offerings are tested, delivered, and improved in real customer environments to shorten time to production and increase successful adoption.</li> <li>Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable templates, architecture guidance, migration patterns, and implementation standards that increase reuse and improve delivery consistency across the broader Professional Services organization.</li> <li>Represent the Technical Architecture practice in AMER Professional Services management discussions and partner with adjacent functions to improve coordination, service evolution, and delivery consistency.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience managing senior technical professionals in a services, consulting, or Professional Services environment, with a strong track record of coaching, performance management, and career development.</li> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab, software development, site reliability and infrastructure engineering, security, cloud architecture, and agile delivery, with enough depth to guide technical direction and build credibility with highly experienced architects.</li> <li>Experience running consultative engagements by linking technical work to business goals and keeping teams focused on customer value and realized outcomes.</li> <li>Experience with technically complex presales work, including discovery, scoping, estimation, solution definition, and risk assessment.</li> <li>Experience running a billable team against utilization targets, with a clear grasp of how utilization, margin, and forecast accuracy drive Professional Services revenue.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments where offerings, priorities, and organizational needs continue to evolve.</li> <li>Experience building or improving repeatable delivery methods such as playbooks, standards, service kits, architecture patterns, or implementation guidance.</li> <li>A servant-leadership style built on empathy and continuous improvement: you remove blockers for your team, act on what retrospectives surface, and build processes that make it easy to do the right thing.</li> <li>Experience leading customer conversations at every level, from platform engineers to the CTO, giving clear feedback, and
